# FutureMarketingAI (FMai)

> FMai builds Clyde, the AI colleague of your agency (Dutch: AI-collega). Clyde works in a loop per client: goals and strategy, research, a content agenda per channel, execution (Clyde creates, the team and the client approve) and reporting that feeds the next goal. 12 skills (10 live, 2 coming soon) and a memory per client. Workspace-priced model since 2026-04-28: Founding Member 997 EUR per month, lifetime rate lock, 15 workspaces included (maximum 10 founding spots), Growth 499 EUR per workspace (2 to 4 brands), Professional 399 EUR per workspace (5 to 14 brands), Enterprise 299 EUR per workspace (15 plus brands). Max 10 new partnerships per year. Data, servers and database in the EU; the language model runs by default at Anthropic (US), on request on Mistral. Application-gated: no self-service signup. Canonical: https://future-marketing.ai. Founder: Daley. Languages: Dutch (source), English, Spanish. Pricing canon: fma-app/src/lib/skills.ts revision 2026-04-28.

## Company

FutureMarketingAI (FMai) is an AI marketing partnership founded by Daley. The product was repositioned in April 2026 from a services agency to a high-touch partnership platform. Based in the Netherlands, serving EU agencies.

Unlike a self-serve SaaS, FMai takes at most 10 new partnerships per year, with application-gated onboarding. Every engagement starts with the Apply form at https://future-marketing.ai/nl/apply and is reviewed by Daley personally within 48 hours. This is deliberate: quality of partnership is the product.

The first client is SkinClarity Club, a Dutch skincare business with 3 Instagram accounts. FutureMarketingAI is the agency for SkinClarity Club, and all 10 of Clyde's live skills are switched on there.

Key facts:

- Brand: FMai (FutureMarketingAI)
- Canonical website: https://future-marketing.ai
- Founder: Daley
- Location: Netherlands (EU)
- Languages: Dutch (source of truth), English, Spanish
- Company type: AI marketing partnership for agencies
- Target market: marketing agencies in NL and the EU with 5 to 20 people managing 5 to 20 client brands
- Data: data, servers and database in the EU. The language model runs by default at Anthropic, a US company; on request we run Clyde on Mistral to keep the language model in the EU too.

## Product: Clyde, the agency's AI colleague

Clyde is the AI colleague of your agency. He is named Clyde everywhere: on the website, in every screen of the dashboard, on WhatsApp and on Telegram.

The loop. Everything hangs on the goal of the client:
- Goal: a strategy session per brand sets the goals, with a projection per channel and the pillars the brand runs on.
- Research: market, competitors, audience and trends, laid under the strategy so every choice has a reason.
- Agenda: from the strategy follows a plan per channel for the whole year, plus the blogs needed to reach the SEO goals.
- Execution: Clyde creates the content. The team and the client approve, and quality gates stop what is not good enough.
- Reporting: reports arrive by themselves and show what works. That goes back to the goal, and the loop starts again.

Control. Per task the agency chooses how independently Clyde works: observe, propose, do and report, or fully on his own. Critical actions such as ad spend are always proposed first. What Clyde did shows in the log on the dashboard.

People. Team members are assigned to clients and see what is ready, what waits for approval and what went live. The agency's client gets their own dashboard where everything is complete and where they approve, their own content library to add photos and video, requests to the agency from that dashboard, and their own Clyde in the dashboard and on WhatsApp.

Entrances. The dashboard for the complete picture. WhatsApp on the go: ask Clyde how things stand, he reports himself when something deviates or waits for you, and the SEO report arrives every Friday; approving happens in the dashboard. A mobile app for approving and steering from your phone is in development.

From post to lead. When someone comments on Instagram with the keyword you chose, Clyde sends a DM with your text; other DMs get an answer from that brand's knowledge or go to the inbox. The DM contains a tracked link, so every click counts for the right client (bots and link scanners excluded). When the form on the client's site is connected, you see how many requests came in through such a link, and per Instagram account where people drop off.

Memory per client. Clyde remembers the conversation, memories from conversations and feedback, and the strategy and research per client. Memories are consolidated daily. Memories about a client belong to that agency and that client.

## The 12 Skills

### Social Media Manager (Live)

The Social Media Manager runs the content process from idea to publication: captions in the brand voice, a content calendar per account, carousels in the house style and performance per post. Publishes to Instagram and LinkedIn after approval; other networks via Postiz on request.

Capabilities:
- AI-generated captions in brand voice
- Scheduling for Instagram and LinkedIn
- Content calendar with drag and drop
- Engagement tracking per post
- Carousels in the house style
- Hashtag strategy per brand

Credit cost: 1 to 2 credits per post.

### Blog Factory (Live)

Blog Factory writes SEO articles from research to publication: keyword research, writing in the brand voice, meta description, heading structure and internal links. Length follows the search intent and the pages that already rank. Publication after approval, to an MDX site, a Shopify blog or a custom connection.

Capabilities:
- Keyword research and topic clustering
- Length according to search intent
- SEO optimization (meta tags, headings, internal links)
- Publication after approval
- Brand voice consistency

Credit cost: 15 credits per article. Each workspace receives 800 credits per month (Founding Member: 8000 credits total).

### Ad Manager (Live)

Ad Manager creates complete ads (copy, static visuals and video) and prepares them for Meta Ads Manager; an ad goes live only after your approval. Then Clyde follows every ad: reach, clicks, conversions, ROAS and ad fatigue, plus variants to test. Ad spend is always proposed first.

Capabilities:
- AI-generated ad copy, static visuals and video ads
- Prepared for Meta Ads Manager, live after approval
- Per-ad performance: conversions, CTR and ROAS
- Ad-fatigue signals with plain-language recommendations
- Variants to test
- Competitor research in the Meta Ad Library

Credit cost: 10 credits per static ad, 20 credits per video ad.

### Reel Builder (Coming soon)

Reel Builder will create short vertical videos (9:16) with a script in the brand voice, captions and music, for Instagram and LinkedIn. Not available yet.

Planned capabilities:
- AI-generated video scripts
- Automatic captions
- Music selection and timing
- Vertical format (9:16)
- Template library

Credit cost: 25 credits per reel. Status: coming soon.

### Voice Agent (Coming soon)

The Voice Agent will answer phone calls with AI, book appointments, answer questions from the knowledge base and hand over to a person when needed. Not available yet.

Planned capabilities:
- Inbound and outbound AI phone calls
- Appointment booking
- Answering questions in natural language
- Call transcripts
- Handover to a person
- Campaign management for outbound calls

Credit cost: 5 credits per minute. Status: coming soon.

### Lead Qualifier (Live)

The Lead Qualifier places an AI chatbot on your website that qualifies visitors, gives every lead a score on profile, intent and conversation quality, and sends the lead via a webhook to the CRM you already use.

Capabilities:
- Embeddable AI chatbot for websites
- Automatic lead scoring
- Leads to your CRM via a webhook
- Conversations and leads searchable per chatbot
- Custom qualification criteria per client

Credit cost: 2 credits per scored conversation.

### Email Management (Live)

Email Management classifies your Gmail or Outlook inbox with AI: categories per client, an urgency per email, status labels and draft replies that are sent only after approval. Every morning you see what came in. This is inbox classification, not email campaigns.

Capabilities:
- AI classification into categories per client
- Smart labels and auto-categorization
- A daily note of what came in
- Urgency per email (1 to 5)
- Draft replies, sent after approval

Credit cost: 5 credits per action.

### ManyChat DM (Live)

ManyChat DM answers Instagram DMs, comments and story replies with keyword triggers: whoever sends the keyword gets the reply you set, with a link. For other messages Clyde writes a draft in the brand voice, and everyone who responds lands in your lead list.

Capabilities:
- Keyword-based DM triggers
- AI drafts in brand voice
- Lead capture in your lead list
- Replies to comments, DMs and story replies
- Every reply logged

Credit cost: 2 credits per 10 DMs.

### Reporting & Analytics (Live)

Reporting & Analytics writes a weekly report per brand, keeps a dashboard per client with data refreshed daily from Instagram, GA4, Search Console, Shopify and Meta Ads, and alerts you when a figure deviates strongly.

Capabilities:
- Automatic weekly performance reports
- Dashboard per client, refreshed daily
- Alerts on strong deviations
- Social, web, sales and ads together
- Custom report generation

Credit cost: 5 credits per report.

### SEO / GEO Analyst (Live)

The SEO/GEO Analyst runs automatic SEO audits, follows your positions via Search Console, monitors Core Web Vitals and tracks how often your brand is cited by AI search engines (ChatGPT, Perplexity, Gemini and Google AI Overviews). Fixes in order of priority. The SEO report arrives on WhatsApp every Friday.

Capabilities:
- Automatic technical SEO audits
- Positions from Search Console
- Core Web Vitals monitoring
- AI citation monitoring (GEO)
- Competitors on Core Web Vitals and new pages
- Prioritized fix recommendations

Credit cost: 5 credits per audit, 3 credits per report.

### Research (Live)

The Research skill runs scheduled research per client on market trends, competitors and news, and answers targeted questions. Every insight carries its source with a link.

Capabilities:
- Scheduled research runs per client
- Trend monitoring in your niche
- Competitor analysis
- Actionable insights and recommendations
- Source citations on every insight

Credit cost: 3 credits per query.

### Clyde (Live)

Clyde is the AI colleague who directs all other skills. Give instructions in plain language and Clyde routes them to the right skill. Works in the dashboard, on WhatsApp and via Telegram, with a memory per client of earlier conversations, preferences and context.

Capabilities:
- Plain-language instructions
- Orchestration of all other skills
- In every screen of the dashboard and on WhatsApp
- Memory and context per client
- Routines and recurring tasks

Credit cost: 1 to 5 credits per chat.

## Tiers and Pricing

All prices in EUR per month excluding VAT unless stated. Workspace-priced model since 2026-04-28. Pricing canon: `fma-app/src/lib/skills.ts`. Workspace tariffs are recalibrated every 6 months based on observed credit usage. Existing contracts are not retroactively adjusted.

Two pricing models:
- Fixed: Founding Member only. Single monthly price, single credit allocation.
- Workspace: monthly price equals pricePerWorkspace times workspaces. Credits scale with workspaces (creditsPerWorkspace times workspaces).

### Founding Member, 997 EUR per month, lifetime rate lock

- Maximum 10 founding spots
- 15 workspaces included, 299 EUR per extra workspace
- 8,000 credits per month
- All 12 skills included (10 live, 2 coming soon)
- Direct founder access plus roadmap influence
- No onboarding fee
- Monthly cancellable; rate locked for life (never raises for founding members)
- Cheaper than the workspace tiers from 3 brands (997 vs 1497 at Growth 499 times 3)

### Growth, 499 EUR per workspace

- 2 to 4 brand workspaces
- 800 credits per workspace per month (1600 to 3200 total)
- All 12 skills included
- 1,997 EUR one-time onboarding
- Email support

### Professional, 399 EUR per workspace

- 5 to 14 brand workspaces
- 800 credits per workspace per month (4000 to 11200 total)
- All 12 skills included
- 3,997 EUR one-time onboarding
- Dedicated Slack channel

### Enterprise, 299 EUR per workspace

- 15 plus brand workspaces (no upper cap)
- 800 credits per workspace per month (12000 plus total)
- All 12 skills included
- 5,997 EUR one-time onboarding
- Dedicated Customer Success Manager

### Credit packs (all tiers)

- Boost: 2,000 credits, 149 EUR
- Scale: 5,000 credits, 297 EUR
- Max: 15,000 credits, 697 EUR

## Case Study: SkinClarity Club

Client: SkinClarity Club, our first client, and FutureMarketingAI is the agency. Skincare: a club, a webshop and the personal account of founder Sindy.

Setup: one workspace for SkinClarity Club with 3 Instagram accounts and one memory for the whole client. Each account has its own audience, tone and agenda.
- @skinclarityclub: main account, treatments, tips and skin knowledge for consumers.
- @sindy_huidtherapeut: the personal authority account of founder Sindy: trust, expertise, personal branding.
- @skinclarityshop: product account for the webshop: launches, bundles and product content.

What runs: all 10 live skills are switched on.
- Social Media Manager: posts and carousels for the 3 accounts, each in its own tone, created and scheduled from the agenda.
- Blog Factory: SEO blogs for skinclarityclub.nl.
- SEO / GEO Analyst: technical SEO, positions and AI citations.
- Reporting & Analytics: a weekly report on Instagram, Shopify and SEO data, plus the SEO report on Friday.
- Research: skincare trends and competitor analysis with sources.
- Email Management: inbox triage with labels and draft replies.
- Clyde: the AI colleague who ties the other skills together, with one memory for the whole client.

Switched on, not yet in use for SkinClarity Club: Lead Qualifier (no chatbot on the site yet), ManyChat DM (no DM conversations yet), Ad Manager (Meta account connected, measured results to follow).

How it works: Clyde creates and schedules from the agenda, the agency approves before anything goes live, and Sindy has her own dashboard and Clyde on WhatsApp. Clyde takes work off the team; people stay in charge.

No result figures are published for this case until they are measured.

## Memory per client

Clyde keeps a memory per client, so you do not have to supply brand context with every prompt:
- The conversation: what is being discussed right now.
- Memories from conversations and feedback: preferences, corrections, what worked and what did not.
- Strategy and research per client: goals, pillars, audience and market.
- Always at hand: the brand voice and the working agreements, such as who approves and which words are not allowed.

Memories are consolidated daily: overlapping memories are merged and memories that are no longer used fade and are archived. Every memory about a client belongs to that agency and that client.

Leaving: after cancellation you have 30 days to take your data with you; after that we delete your workspaces.

## How it Works

Application-gated, no self-service signup. Max 10 partnerships per year.

Step 1, Apply (5 min): submit the Apply form at https://future-marketing.ai/nl/apply. Name, email, agency and role are required; preferred tier, revenue band, number of clients, urgency and a short problem statement are optional.

Step 2, Founder Review (within 48 hours): Daley personally reviews every application. If accepted, he schedules a 30-minute Strategy Call.

Step 3, Strategy Call (30 min): honest assessment of which tier and skills deliver the most impact. We assess your client portfolio and pick the right starting setup.

Step 4, Onboarding (4 weeks): we connect the accounts, brand voice and knowledge, run the strategy session per client, and set up Clyde, the content agenda and the approvals.

Step 5, Correction Loop (month 1): Clyde calibrates on real feedback. Corrections are stored in the client's memory and used in the next request.

Step 6, Quarterly Strategy plus Annual Retrospective: quarterly check-ins on what is working. Annual retrospective with full performance review.

## HowTo: Start met FutureMarketingAI

Type: HowTo
Name: Hoe start ik met FutureMarketingAI?
Description: Stap-voor-stap van aanvraag tot een AI-collega die meedraait in je bureau, met Clyde ingericht voor elke klant.
TotalTime: PT4W

Step 1 - Dien je aanvraag in (5 minuten)
Ga naar https://future-marketing.ai/nl/apply en vul het aanvraagformulier in. Naam, e-mailadres, bureau en rol zijn verplicht. Extra context over je portfolio en doelen is welkom maar niet verplicht.

Step 2 - Persoonlijke beoordeling door Daley (binnen 48 uur)
Daley beoordeelt elke aanvraag persoonlijk. Als er een goede match is, plant hij direct een Strategy Call in. Geen automatische afwijzingen, geen verkoopscript.

Step 3 - Strategy Call (30 minuten)
Een eerlijk gesprek over welk tier en welke vaardigheden het meeste impact hebben voor jouw portfolio. We kiezen de juiste startopzet samen.

Step 4 - Onboarding (4 weken)
We koppelen de accounts, merkstem en kennis, doen de strategiesessie per klant en richten Clyde, de content-agenda en de goedkeuringen in. Geen technische kennis vereist van jouw kant.

Step 5 - Correctielus (maand 1)
Clyde kalibreert op echte feedback. Correcties komen in het geheugen van die klant, en Clyde gebruikt ze bij het volgende verzoek.

Step 6 - Kwartaalcheck en jaarlijkse retrospective
Elk kwartaal een strategisch gesprek over wat werkt. Jaarlijks een volledige performance review met roadmap-update.

## FAQPage: Veelgestelde vragen over FutureMarketingAI

Type: FAQPage
URL: https://future-marketing.ai

Q: Wat kost FutureMarketingAI?
A: Founding Member kost 997 EUR per maand, levenslang vast tarief, maandelijks opzegbaar, met 15 werkruimtes inbegrepen (daarboven 299 EUR per extra werkruimte) en maximaal 10 plekken. Growth kost 499 euro per werkruimte per maand (2 tot 4 merken). Professional kost 399 euro per werkruimte per maand (5 tot 14 merken). Enterprise kost 299 euro per werkruimte per maand (15 of meer merken). De tarieven per werkruimte worden halfjaarlijks herijkt op het werkelijke creditverbruik. Geen onboardingkosten voor Founding.

Q: Kan ik stoppen wanneer ik wil?
A: Ja. Alle tiers, inclusief Founding, zijn maandelijks opzegbaar. Founding is geen eenmalige betaling maar een maandelijks abonnement met een levenslang vast tarief: je betaalt altijd 997 EUR per maand, het tarief stijgt nooit.

Q: Voor welke bureaus is FutureMarketingAI geschikt?
A: Voor marketingbureaus in Nederland en de EU met 5 tot 20 mensen die 5 tot 20 klantmerken beheren, en die meer klanten willen bedienen met het team dat ze hebben. De pakketten beginnen bij 2 merken.

Q: Hoelang duurt de onboarding?
A: De onboarding duurt 4 weken: accounts koppelen, merkstem en kennis, een strategiesessie per klant, en Clyde, de agenda en de goedkeuringen inrichten. Maand 1 is de correctielus. Per taak kies je daarna hoe zelfstandig Clyde werkt.

Q: Is mijn data veilig?
A: Je data, servers en database staan in de EU. Het taalmodel draait standaard bij Anthropic, een Amerikaans bedrijf; wil je het taalmodel ook in de EU, dan zetten we Clyde op verzoek op Mistral. Elke klant heeft een eigen werkruimte, en herinneringen over een klant horen bij dat bureau en die klant. Na opzegging heb je 30 dagen om je gegevens mee te nemen; daarna verwijderen we je werkruimtes.

Q: Kan Clyde meerdere merken tegelijk beheren?
A: Ja. Elke klant krijgt een eigen werkruimte met een eigen merkstem, geheugen, agenda en goedkeuringen. Binnen een klant kunnen meerdere accounts vallen, zoals bij SkinClarity Club met 3 Instagram-accounts.

Q: Welke platformen ondersteunt Clyde?
A: Publiceren op Instagram en LinkedIn; andere netwerken via Postiz op verzoek. Blogs naar een MDX-site, een Shopify-blog of een eigen koppeling. Advertenties op Meta. Data voor de rapporten uit Instagram, GA4, Search Console, Shopify en Meta Ads. E-mail in Gmail en Outlook. Leads via een webhook naar je eigen CRM. Clyde zelf in het dashboard, op WhatsApp en op Telegram.

Q: Hoe werkt de goedkeuringsflow?
A: Per taak kies je hoe zelfstandig Clyde werkt: meekijken, voorstellen, doen en melden, of helemaal zelf. Wat Clyde voorlegt, keuren jij of je klant goed in het dashboard; Clyde meldt op WhatsApp wanneer er iets op goedkeuring wacht. Afwijzen met commentaar komt in het geheugen van die klant, en Clyde gebruikt het bij het volgende verzoek.

Q: Wat is het verschil tussen Founding en Growth?
A: Founding kost 997 EUR per maand met een levenslang vast tarief, 15 werkruimtes inbegrepen, maximaal 10 plekken en een directe Slack-lijn met Daley. Growth is 499 euro per werkruimte per maand (2 tot 4 merken) en wordt halfjaarlijks herijkt. Beide zijn maandelijks opzegbaar.

Q: Kan ik FutureMarketingAI eerst uitproberen?
A: Er is geen gratis trial. Wel is er een eerlijk strategiegesprek van 30 minuten voordat je betaalt. Als de match er niet is, zeggen we dat direct. Het aanvraagproces is vrijblijvend.
